title: Intrinsic identity coherence for finite dualizing restriction
statement: For every coefficient level n, the inverse intrinsic restriction comparison followed by the normalized DVR identity unit equals the comparison-site identity restriction unit transported through the intrinsic realization equivalence.

source.place: Identity normalization of the intrinsic comparison

proof.text: Unfold the two whiskered iso compositions. The section-normalized intrinsic comparison is uniquely determined by its scalar-unit sections, and exact localization preserves this identity square.

proof_origin.place: Identity normalization of the intrinsic comparison

mathlib_searches.query: normalized identity restriction intrinsic derived comparison

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction_unit (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X (le_refl n)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor
          (normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n) ≪≫
        Functor.rightUnitor _ =
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
            (ProEtale.normalizedOriginRestrictionUnit (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              (finiteDualizingQuotient l E (le_refl n))
              (by rw [finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n])) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _)
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor ≪≫
        Functor.leftUnitor _
